name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on the bench and keep feet stable.
Lower the bar under control, then press back up.

name: Barbell Full Squat
instructions: Brace your trunk and squat to a controlled depth.
Drive up through the feet while keeping your back stable.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Push hips back with slight knee bend.
Return to standing with a controlled hip drive.

name: Seated Cable Rows
instructions: Keep a neutral back and pull toward your torso.
Return slowly without rounding excessively.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar to the upper chest without swinging.
Extend your arms slowly.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench to a modest incline.
Press dumbbells evenly under control.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Keep elbows close and curl without swinging.

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Keep elbows by your sides and extend the arms.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Lower the platform while keeping your back supported.
Press up without locking knees forcefully.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Bend your knees against the resistance, then release slowly.

name: Leg Extensions
instructions: Extend knees against the resistance then lower slowly.

name: Push-Ups
instructions: Hold a straight body position and lower under control.
Push back up without sagging through the trunk.
